headline: What Royal Caribbean's earnings signal for the cruise industry
summary: Royal Caribbean Cruises stock (RCL) has caught some wind in its sails on Tuesday, holding onto post-earnings gains ahead of the close after trimming its full-year yield forecast. UBS managing director and leisure analyst Robin Farley examines how Royal Caribbean and Carnival Corporation's (CCL) quarterly results set the stage for Norwegian Cruise Line's (NCLH) own release, as well as how oil prices (CL=F, BZ=F) impact the cruise industry as a whole.
